title: 前台②：课程咨询
titleEn: We have a free trial class
goal: 家长来问课程时，能问孩子的年龄和年级，介绍试听课、上课时间和学费。

chunks.note: 新加坡说 Primary 1（小一）、P1。男孩就说 Which level is he in?

chunks.en: We have a free trial class.
chunks.note: trial class = 试听课，free = 免费。

chunks.en: The class is on Saturday at 10am.

chunks.note: $280 读作 two hundred and eighty dollars。

chunks.en: Can I have your phone number?
chunks.zh: 可以给我你的电话号码吗？

chunks.note: 新加坡人常常把 WhatsApp 当动词用，意思是"发 WhatsApp 消息"。

grammar.title: $280 a month 就是"每个月 280"
grammar.body: 价格或者次数后面加 a month / a week，意思是"每个月 / 每星期"。这里的 a 不是"一个"，而是"每"。

dialogue.title: 家长来问华文课
dialogue.setting: 一位妈妈走进补习中心，想给女儿报华文课。

npc.en: Hi, I want to ask about Chinese classes for my daughter.
npc.zh: 你好，我想问一下我女儿的华文课。

replies.en: We have a free trial class.

npc.en: Oh good. When is the class?
npc.zh: 哦，太好了。什么时候上课？

replies.en: The class is on Saturday at 10am.

npc.en: Okay, I think we can try.

replies.en: Can I have your phone number?
replies.zh: 可以给我你的电话号码吗？

replies.en: Thank you. I will WhatsApp you.
replies.zh: 谢谢，我会发 WhatsApp 给你。

npc.en: Thank you, see you on Saturday!

task: 今天有家长来问课程时，试着用英语说一句 We have a free trial class.
